latest_release.name: OpenMAIC v1.4.2 — Course-level undo
latest_release.body:
1.4.2 is a regular patch release. Its main addition is **course-level undo**: one undo/redo line per course that covers manual edits, page add/delete/reorder, narration, titles and agent runs, with buttons in the workbench header and Cmd/Ctrl+Z. It also stops a Director from retrying a failing child agent without end (the 1.4.0 known issue [#2122](https://github.com/THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC/issues/2122)), keeps Pro edits from leaving an interactive page empty, lets `ALLOW_LOCAL_NETWORKS` cover TUN/fake-ip proxies, and carries a batch of PBL v3 fixes plus Java application previews. There are no schema or migration changes over 1.4.1. Read **Behavior Changes** before upgrading: sandboxes are no longer limited to one role, and `ASSET_COLLECTION_GRACE_MS` must stay at 45 minutes or more.

### Behavior Changes

- Sandbox: once a deployment enables sandboxes, any owner it admits may use them, including anonymous and shared-team owners; the `sandbox:use` role and the single-user requirement are gone, and `SANDBOX_FORBIDDEN` is no longer returned. Model calls were never gated by identity either. Each owner still reaches only its own sandboxes, files, previews and checkpoints. **On an anonymous public deployment this lets any visitor start billable sandboxes up to `maxActivePerOwner` and `maxActive`**: protect it with `ACCESS_CODE` or your own sign-in, keep the caps and lifetime low, and set a budget at the sandbox provider. See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC/blob/main/SECURITY.md#deployment-assumptions). [#2191](https://github.com/THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC/pull/2191)
- Network: `ALLOW_LOCAL_NETWORKS=true` now also allows `198.18.0.0/15`, the range TUN/fake-ip proxies (Clash, Surge, Shadowrocket and similar) answer DNS with for public hostnames, so operator-configured TTS, image and other providers work behind such a proxy. It applies only to that block and only to operator-configured endpoints; client-supplied endpoints and the other reserved ranges stay refused. The refusal now names the proxy and suggests excluding the provider's domain from fake-ip, which remains the preferred fix. [#2186](https://github.com/THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC/pull/2186) (by @hackdion)
- Storage: `ASSET_COLLECTION_GRACE_MS` below 45 minutes (2700000) is unsupported, because undo can restore a reference to media removed up to 45 minutes earlier. The default (one hour) is unaffected. [#2159](https://github.com/THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC/pull/2159)

### Features

- Editor: course-level undo and redo. Each open course keeps one in-memory history of up to 100 steps that survives page, mode and course-tab switches and clears on reload. It covers slide and quiz edits (a burst of typing is one step), narration, page titles, page add, duplicate, delete and reorder, and agent changes (one run is one step). Buttons sit in the workbench header and the standalone command bar on every scene type, with Cmd/Ctrl+Z and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z. The workbench had no undo since 1.0.0. [#2159](https://github.com/THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC/pull/2159)
- PBL v3: Java packages can run application previews. The declared sources are compiled with `javac` and the declared main class is launched through the existing preview lifecycle; packages that need it declare `pbl-v3-java-application@1`, so an older host rejects them explicitly. [#2188](https://github.com/THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC/pull/2188) (by @Irisdai517)
- PBL v3: course packages can give a choice option a `previewLabel` for the application preview; the decision drawer keeps the short `label`, which stays the fallback. [#2201](https://github.com/THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC/pull/2201) (by @Irisdai517)

### Bug Fixes

- Classroom: a Director no longer retries a teacher or assistant that keeps failing. A failed, timed-out or empty child call now comes back to the Director as a clear failure, after which it may call another agent or hand the turn back to the learner.
